svg.title: M365 token spray and replay - stolen sessions to rogue devices and BEC
svg.desc: Two-lane kill chain. Left lane: 1 stolen session or credential captured by AiTM, device-code phishing or social engineering, 2 token replay from 1337 Services hosts in 193.26.115.0/24 with scripted or browser tooling, 3 spray volume versus valid credential (AADSTS53003), 4 rogue DESKTOP-hex Entra devices, 5 MFA methods wiped and replaced, 6 hiding inbox rules, 7 BEC follow-on to payroll. Right lane: attribution, campaign phases, Conditional Access lessons, indicators, detection anchors and response. Anchors: Sigma 01-05, KQL k1-k3, Suricata 6450001-3, hunts H1-H3.
svg.text: Huntress: M365 token replay from stolen sessions to BEC
Vendor: Huntress - Date: 2026-10-22 - Cluster: unattributed (1337 Services infra) - Day 127
VICTIM SIDE: TOKEN THEFT TO MAIL ABUSE
CAMPAIGN, INFRASTRUCTURE AND DEFENDER VIEW
Stolen session or credential captured
AiTM relay, device-code phishing, social engineering at login
Victim reaches the MFA prompt; hijacked session appears 4-12 min later
79 organizations hit between 2026-07-14 and 2026-09-22
Sigma 02 KQL k1 Suricata 6450003 Hunt H1
Token replay from 1337 Services hosts
193.26.115.0/24 (AS210558); six main replay hosts, rotated often
Build A: node or bare Mozilla/5.0, OAuth2:Token, Office and Broker
Build B: Chrome or Edge, OfficeHome, Login:reprocess
Sigma 01, 02 KQL k1 Suricata 6450001-2
Spray volume vs valid credential
200,000+ failed attempts, 497 successful sign-ins
AADSTS53003 means valid credential blocked by Conditional Access
AADSTS50133 means a revoked or invalid session was replayed
KQL k1 Hunt H1
Rogue Entra devices via Device Registration
At least 48 devices named DESKTOP- plus eight hex characters
Token for Device Registration Service (01cb2876-...) with Broker app
A password reset does not remove them
Sigma 03 KQL k2 Hunt H2
MFA methods wiped and replaced
19 organizations: new method within three hours of first sign-in
Example attacker authenticator labelled iPhone 13
Persists after reset; the access token lasts about 90 minutes
Sigma 04 KQL k2 Hunt H2
Hiding inbox rules and mailbox abuse
Names like . sss iT d; moves to RSS Feeds or Conversation History
Four rules created through the Outlook REST API
Spam sent from the mailbox; hide payroll, bank, bonus mail
Sigma 05 KQL k3 Hunt H3
Business email compromise follow-on
Payroll-themed email to an outside CPA in one incident
Mailbox used to message partners and finance
Payment or payroll change is the business impact
Hunt H3 YARA 2
A
Attribution: no actor named
Huntress names no threat actor
Infrastructure ties to 1337 Services GmbH (Hamburg)
Krebs 2025 links the founder to the Cracked forum
Repo link: AiTM case TA419 of 2026-10-05
Huntress 2026-10-22 confidence low (actor)
B
Campaign phases
1: Jul 14 - Aug 3, 37 orgs, 37 rogue devices
2: from Aug 17, device-code phishing, MFA wipes
3: Sep 11-15, 303 successes in 29 orgs (article)
4: Sep 2-22, Evoxt relay, final takeover Sep 22
Counts differ inside the post; treat as approximate
C
Conditional Access lessons
Require MFA or block for all users, apps, client types
Restrict the device-code flow with authentication flow policy
Disable user consent; require admin review of apps
Treat AADSTS53003 as proof of a valid credential
Prioritize by credential validity, not volume
D
Indicators and limits
No file hashes: this is cloud log evidence only
Hosting addresses rotate; blocking one stops little
iocs.csv 41 rows YARA 2 rules
E
Detection anchors
Published block or scripted client on Office or Broker app
DESKTOP-hex device or MFA delete then register
Short or punctuation rule name, RSS or Conversation History
Join all three per user: sign-in, persistence, mail rule
Sigma 01-05 KQL k1-k3 Suricata 6450001-3
F
Response and caveats
Revoke sessions first, then reset the password
Delete rogue devices and unknown MFA methods
Review sent items, rules and payroll changes
Block the /24 knowing other ranges exist
Hunts H1 H2 H3
Anchors: 193.26.115.0/24 sign-ins, scripted Office clients, DESKTOP-hex devices, MFA wipe, hiding rules
Rules in this folder: Sigma 01-05, KQL k1-k3, YARA 2 rules, Suricata sids 6450001-6450003, PEAK hunts H1-H3.
No CVE in scope, so no kev.md. No file hashes: evidence is cloud logs; hosting addresses rotate, re-validate before blocking.
Act: revoke sessions, remove rogue devices and MFA methods, delete hiding rules, hunt H1 to H3, warn payroll and finance.
